E03.mask_hash_rule: SHA256 of selected row_ids in training order, little-endian int64
E03.sampling: class-stratified nested permutations; ceil per class; labels used only to simulate annotation
E03.fitting: LR sees only labeled rows; IF sees all unlabeled training features; hidden labels never become 0

E05.case_rule: two FP closest inside K; two FN closest outside K; two highest-ranked FP; score desc,row_id asc; categories may overlap
